reply.text: {"say":"Full leg day: a leg press to open, a Romanian deadlift for hamstrings, single-leg work, then curls, calves and a glute finisher, with no barbell squats.","title":"Leg Day","days":[{"name":"Leg Day","exercises":[{"key":"machine-leg-press","sets":4,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full depth, controlled lowering."},{"key":"barbell-romanian-deadlift","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hinge back, flat spine, feel the hamstrings."},{"key":"dumbbell-bulgarian-split-squat","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Torso tall, rear foot on a bench."},{"key":"lying-leg-curl-machine","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slow lowering on every rep."},{"key":"leg-extension-machine","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze at the top."},{"key":"standing-calf-raise-machine","sets":4,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause at the bottom stretch."},{"key":"barbell-hip-thrust","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause and squeeze at lockout."}]}],"unmet":[]}
